name: Amsterdam
tagline: Raw herring by the station since 1903, and fine dining with a panoramic view from the 23rd floor.

Ciel Bleu.description: French haute cuisine with panoramic views from atop the Hotel Okura. Two Michelin stars.

Stubbe's Haring.description: Amsterdam's most famous herring stand, next to Central Station since 1903.

De Kas.description: A restaurant inside a 1920s greenhouse that grows its own vegetables.

Flore.description: Inside the Hotel de l'Europe, minimalist, sustainable, dairy-free cuisine from chef Bas van Kranen. Two Michelin stars and a Green Star.

Foodhallen.description: A food market inside a former Oud-West tram depot, with more than 20 international food stalls.
